result.brief: 提出路由式表征对齐（RouteREPA），用轻量路由器按深度自适应分配任务导向表征，缓解像素空间生成与判别对齐的冲突。
result.reason: Proposes routed representation alignment for pixel-space image transformers, analyzing representation conflict between discriminative alignment and generation; a representation-learning contribution transferable to RAE-style latent design.
